PURPOSE: Decision-authority mechanics for PING's capability-kernel: PDP/PEP decision-request contract, decision-receipt (audit) schema with full input+output capture and per-action policy lineage, policy module-ID versioning, and the PlanResources residual-condition pattern. Re-derived clean-room; no Cerbos code or runtime adopted.
SMALLEST_MISSING_PRIMITIVE: DecisionReceipt — canonical evidence-grade record of one capability evaluation: {receipt_id (ULID, joinable to request + event journal), evaluated_at, evaluator, actor_id, action(s), target_ref{kind,id}, context_digest sha256 of canonical context, policy_ref{policy_id, policy_version, scope}, matched_rule, effects{action: ALLOW|DENY}, derived_roles}. Recorded append-only per evaluation that gates a mission-critical effect.
SOURCE_PATH: docs.cerbos.dev (API index, admin API, audit config), github.com/cerbos/cerbos (README, PR #960 DecisionLogEntry example), cerbos.dev blogs (PDP vs Hub logs, audit-trail doctrine, policy test CI gate)
